name: Za'tachk

traits.name: Boldness (BOL)
traits.description: Za'tachk have a seventh characteristic, Boldness (BOL), measuring will and courage versus self-preservation. Roll BOL as 1D+1. Low BOL = strong self-preservation; BOL 7+ is seen as recklessly courageous (and somewhat unstable); 10+ is considered insane by other Za'tachk. In any physically dangerous situation a Za'tachk must pass an Average (8+) BOL check to keep acting normally, or retreat to safety; failing by Effect -6+ drops them into a brief catatonic state. Caste variants: Matriarchs take INT+1, EDU+1, BOL-1; Scouts take INT-1, EDU-1, BOL+1.

traits.name: Brachiator
traits.description: Exemplary climbers who use all limbs as locomotors or manipulators: DM+2 when climbing or swinging, and DM+2 to checks made to stabilise or keep their footing on unstable or precarious flooring where handholds are available.

traits.name: Coward
traits.description: Psychologically timid and frightened of violence. If threatened or attacked within 50 metres, a Za'tachk must immediately pass a BOL check (usually Average 8+) or abandon their action and take a defensive measure (flee, seek high ground, hide). Failing by Effect -6+ drops them into a catatonic state for rounds equal to the Effect. Even on a success they suffer DM-2 to all actions while under the threat.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4, Mongoose Publishing
